audience: real estate agents and brokers who manage properties and clients in Propstack

useCases.title: List properties for sale or rent
useCases.text: The AI lists properties by status, marketing type (buy or rent), project or tag, with address, rooms, areas and prices.

useCases.title: See viewings and appointments in a time window
useCases.text: The AI lists calendar events in a time window with title, place, times and the linked contact and property.

useCases.title: Review deals by pipeline stage
useCases.text: The AI reads the deal pipelines and lists deals by stage or category, linking each contact to a property.

useCases.title: Look up, add or update a contact
useCases.text: The AI searches contacts or opens one, and creates a contact or updates the fields you name.

useCases.title: Create or update a note, to-do or appointment
useCases.text: The AI creates a note, a to-do with a due date or an appointment, linked to contacts or properties, and can mark a to-do done or reschedule it.

useCases.title: Create a deal or move it to another stage
useCases.text: The AI creates a deal that links a contact to a property in a stage, or moves a deal to another stage.
